info.headline: Notify NYC - Silver Alert - Gloria Rosario (NYC)
info.description:
Silver Alert issued 10-09-2026 at 07:15 AM.
A Silver Alert has been issued for Gloria Rosario, a 90-year-old black female, last seen near East 62nd Street and Lexington Avenue in Manhattan at approximately 4:00 PM on 10-08-2026. Ms. Rosario has dementia, may seem disoriented, and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: She has gray hair and was last seen wearing black pants, a long black coat, black shoes, a beige shirt, and a navy-blue cap with a red logo.
If you see Gloria, please call 1-800-577-8477 (TIPS) or 9-1-1.
A photo of Gloria is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sFj41H
